DESCRIPTION.general: General configuration for the File Integrity utility.
DESCRIPTION.general.algorithm: Hash algorithm used for file hashing, comparison, duplicate detection, and checksum manifests.
DESCRIPTION.general.target_dir: Base directory inspected by File Integrity. Directory operations use this path automatically and file selections are resolved relative to this directory.
DESCRIPTION.general.manifest_dir: Directory where checksum manifests are stored. Relative paths are resolved from the program working directory.
